integrity: Infinite claims follow from explicit aligned-block induction and the standard published greedy-arch characterization. Computations independently corroborate finite cases. No independent audit or external mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only base b>=2 with modulus exactly b+1 and full b+1-symbol ambient alphabet; no formula for other moduli or circular universality. Originality may be affected by unindexed equivalent results. Finite verification is not an infinite proof.
title: Exact scattered-subsequence universality of digit-sum words modulo base plus one
